regime_context: The detector shows a broad but low-cohesion leadership structure: Silver & Royalties leads on rank (1.875) but its own hurst_tag is mean-revert, and durability is middling (0.61) with the rotation margin over Gold Miners thin (0.137). Breadth of eligible themes is wide (56%), one-narrative is false, and absorption is only 0.31 — this is a diversified, non-committal leadership picture, not a concentrated trend. Validated edge is limited to drawdown control via the trend gate (gate_helps true), and the track record's directional accuracy is weak (0.386), so leans should be modest.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver & Royalties' mean-revert hurst tag retires its leadership: if the spread between XGD.TO (Silver & Royalties proxy) and Gold Miners' XGD.TO closes to zero and Silver's durability bar falls below 0.60 while remaining the rank leader, the leadership handoff to Gold Miners becomes confirmed.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners ranks 2 with a score of 1.738, the best durability bar of the top themes (0.67), perfect breadth (1.0), and non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.60). It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the one validated leg. The leader Silver & Royalties has a mean-revert hurst tag and slightly lower durability, making Gold Miners the steadier of the two precious-metals complexes on trend-gate grounds.
theses.dissent: This is a momentum-attention lens with rank-IC near zero, so high score does not imply returns. Precious metals leadership can stall quickly, and the margin over the leader is thin. The track record's directional accuracy (0.386) warns against conviction.
